chunks: Obedience and modest speech (would have been more becoming). And when the matter has been determined it is best for them to be true to God.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of being truthful to God when the command is decided?
ai.summary: In the context of the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah, this verse addresses the believers' hesitation and subsequent lack of full commitment when the final decision to proceed was made. Shia scholars emphasize that 'truthfulness to God' (sidq) here refers to unwavering sincerity in executing divine commands without reservation, highlighting that partial obedience often leads to missed spiritual opportunities.
